name: sampling_stream
description: default_rng(random_seed); sequential rng.random(simulation_iterations) vectors in sampling_order; common random numbers; no resampling.

name: sampling_order
description: lumber_cost_index|framing_labor_productivity|mechanical_electrical_plumbing_cost_index|permit_delay|weather_delay|change_order_percentage

name: distribution_conventions
description: truncated_normal: scipy.stats.truncnorm.ppf with standardized bounds|truncated_lognormal: arithmetic mean/CV parameterization and CDF(min)-CDF(max) remap before scipy.stats.lognorm.ppf|triangular: scipy.stats.triang.ppf with c=(mode-min)/(max-min), mean column=mode.

name: combination_index
description: 1-based Cartesian product wall_system|roof_form|exterior_cladding|energy_package|contractor; listed order; leftmost slowest.

name: quantity_model
description: gross_wall=2*(40+30)*9*2; net_wall=gross_wall-0.18*gross_wall+620; roof_area=((40+4)*(30+4)+(20+4)*(24+4))*sqrt(1+(6/12)^2)*roof_area_factor*1.08.

name: trade_cost_model
description: framing_multiplier=0.62*lumber_cost_index+0.38/(framing_labor_productivity*wall_labor_factor); wall_framing=net_wall*26*framing_factor*framing_multiplier*advanced_wall_factor; second_floor=21600*framing_multiplier; roof=roof_area*32*roof_cost_factor*framing_multiplier*roof_factor; cladding=net_wall*cladding_unit_cost*cladding_factor; windows=52000*window_factor; mechanical_electrical_plumbing=165000*mechanical_electrical_plumbing_factor*mechanical_electrical_plumbing_cost_index; trade_subtotal=sum(all trade and fixed scope costs)+net_wall*wall_adder.

name: contractor_normalization
description: covered=max(trade_subtotal-excluded_scope,0); normalized_construction=(bid_factor*covered+general_conditions+allowance*allowance_factor)*(1+fee_rate)+excluded_scope*outside_scope_factor.

name: phase_model
description: phase1=sitework+foundation; phase2=wall_framing+second_floor+roof+garage+wildland_urban_interface; phase3=cladding+windows+net_wall*wall_adder+doors; phase4=mechanical_electrical_plumbing+energy_package; phase5=interior+closeout; phase_base_cost=normalized_construction*phase_trade_basis/trade_subtotal; durations=(55+permit_delay)|(duration_factor*(65*wall_duration+45*roof_duration)/framing_labor_productivity)|(duration_factor*40*cladding_duration+0.65*weather_delay)|(55+package_duration+0.15*weather_delay)|(80+0.20*weather_delay); change_exposure=0.35|0.90|1.00|1.35|0.85, with phase2-3 *1.35 for advanced framing.

name: initial_phase_state
description: elapsed_days=0|financed_balance=0|finance_cost=0|delay_cost=0|initial_allowance=allowance*allowance_factor|remaining_allowance=initial_allowance|raw_change_to_date=0|change_control_active=false|recourse_spend=0|intensive_count=0|carry_d=1|carry_x=1.

name: phase_state_update
description: duration=phase_duration*carry_d*d; base=phase_base_cost*c; exposure=change_exposure*carry_x*x; midpoint=start+0.5*duration; escalated=base*(1+annual_escalation_rate)^(midpoint/365); raw_change=escalated*change_order_percentage*change_order_factor*(change_control_factor if active else 1)*stress_change_factor*exposure; allowance_used=min(remaining_allowance,raw_change); phase_cash=escalated+raw_change-allowance_used+action_fee; finance_increment=annual_financing_rate*(financed_balance+0.5*phase_cash)*duration/365; late_days=max(end-schedule_target,0)-max(start-schedule_target,0); commit cash, finance, delay, allowance, raw_change, elapsed_days, recourse spend/count, next carry factors; allowance_utilization=(initial_allowance-remaining_allowance)/initial_allowance; after phase3, allowance_utilization>0.70 activates change control and adds change_control_fee once after phase3 financing.

name: information_release
description: phase1:permit_delay|phase2:+lumber_cost_index,+framing_labor_productivity|phase3:+weather_delay|phase4:+mechanical_electrical_plumbing_cost_index|phase5:+change_order_percentage; low/medium/high from input bin rows.

name: nonanticipativity
description: At a phase, scenarios with the same released-information bins and prior action history use one common action.

name: recourse_policy
description: Finite-horizon backward induction over information nodes. Eligible actions come from input recourse rows and remaining recourse budget/count. terminal_score=max(total_owner_cost/budget_limit,duration_days/schedule_target,raw_change_to_date/(1.25*initial_allowance))+0.04*recourse_spend/recourse_budget+0.02*intensive_count/maximum_intensive_recourse_count. node_value=(1-policy_tail_weight)*mean(terminal_score)+policy_tail_weight*mean(largest ceil(policy_tail_fraction*n_node) terminal_score). Ties: lower mean total cost -> lower mean duration -> lower mean raw change -> lower mean recourse spend -> listed action order.

name: project_metrics
description: total_owner_cost=financed_balance+finance_cost+delay_cost+owner_fixed_costs+mitigation_fee; p90=quantile(total_owner_cost,0.90,method='linear'); budget_overrun=P(total_owner_cost>budget_limit); schedule_overrun=P(duration_days>schedule_target); energy_margin=wall_energy+package_energy-roof_energy_penalty-0.05.

name: baseline_feasibility
description: energy_margin>=0 AND budget_overrun<=0.35 AND schedule_overrun<=0.40 AND p90<=percentile_90_cost_limit; unrounded.

name: baseline_selection
description: feasible: expected_total_cost asc -> p90 asc -> schedule_overrun asc -> combination_index asc|none feasible: energy_margin desc -> budget_overrun asc -> schedule_overrun asc -> p90 asc -> combination_index asc.

name: verification_case
description: scenario indices and all stated order-statistic ranks are 1-based. scenario_risk=terminal_score; nominal derived_verification_case_index=actual scenario index at ascending rank 2850, ties smaller scenario index.

name: sensitivity_mitigation
description: baseline sensitivity=absolute Spearman(input,total_owner_cost) for nominal design. At derived verification scenario, local relief replaces one input by its baseline median while holding that scenario's realized action path fixed. Eligible mitigation=top3 local relief ∩ top4 sensitivity ∩ mitigation inputs; candidate value=re-optimized nominal expected cost using remapped stored uniforms; net_benefit=baseline expected cost-candidate expected cost before fee-fee; select max positive, ties local relief -> sensitivity -> sampling_order; else NONE.

name: post_mitigation
description: Remap only selected driver's stored uniforms; add fee; re-optimize nonanticipative policy for every combination; apply baseline feasibility/selection. Using the post-mitigation-selected combination, form its phase3_checkpoint_risk vector over all scenarios. At the end of phase3 after the change-control event: phase3_elapsed=elapsed_days, phase3_raw_change=raw_change_to_date, phase3_committed_cost=financed_balance+finance_cost+delay_cost. post_mitigation_verification_case_index=actual scenario index at ascending phase3_checkpoint_risk rank 2910, ties smaller scenario index; phase3_checkpoint_risk=max(phase3_elapsed/(0.68*schedule_target),(phase3_committed_cost+0.55*owner_fixed_costs+mitigation_fee)/(0.67*budget_limit),phase3_raw_change/(1.25*initial_allowance)).

name: market_stress
description: From the post-mitigation-selected combination at post_mitigation_verification_case_index: cost_ratio=(phase3_committed_cost+0.55*owner_fixed_costs+mitigation_fee)/(0.67*budget_limit); change_ratio=phase3_raw_change/(1.25*initial_allowance); market_shock_factor=1+0.30*max(cost_ratio-0.90,0)+0.18*max(change_ratio-0.80,0); phase4_mep_factor=1+0.85*(market_shock_factor-1); market_change_factor=1+1.10*(market_shock_factor-1). Apply these fixed market-stress factors to every combination. For each combination, freeze its own phases1-3 post-mitigation actions/states. For phase4, add normalized_construction*(mechanical_electrical_plumbing/trade_subtotal)*(phase4_mep_factor-1) to phase4_base_cost before recourse evaluation. For phases4-5, stress_change_factor=market_change_factor. Re-optimize the nonanticipative phase4-5 policy for every combination; apply baseline feasibility/selection on the completed market paths.

name: delivery_stress
description: From the market-selected combination, p_late4=P(phase4_end>0.82*schedule_target); p_control=P(change_control_active); delivery_duration_factor=1+0.22*p_late4+0.08*p_control; delivery_change_factor=1+0.35*p_late4+0.20*p_control. Apply these fixed delivery-stress factors to every combination. For each combination, freeze its own phase1-4 market actions/states. Before phase5 recourse evaluation, phase_duration*=delivery_duration_factor and stress_change_factor=market_change_factor*delivery_change_factor. Re-optimize the nonanticipative phase5 policy for every combination; apply baseline feasibility/selection on the completed delivery paths.

name: stress_metrics
description: market_risk=max(market_cost/budget_limit,market_duration/schedule_target); delivery_risk=max(delivery_cost/budget_limit,delivery_duration/schedule_target); joint_success=(market_risk<=1 AND delivery_risk<=1); sequential_peak=max(market_risk,delivery_risk); cvar95=mean(largest 150 sequential_peak).

name: robust_feasibility
description: post-mitigation feasible AND market feasible AND delivery feasible AND sequential_peak at post_mitigation_verification_case_index<=1.10 AND mean(joint_success)>=0.95 AND cvar95<=1.08; unrounded.

name: cost_worlds
description: For each candidate, compute p_late_recourse and p_early_recourse from that candidate's post-mitigation baseline recourse paths. world1=post-mitigation baseline total_owner_cost|world2=world1+0.045*p_late_recourse*normalized_construction for candidates using market-selected contractor, where p_late_recourse=P(phase4 or phase5 nonstandard action)|world3=world1+0.12*p_early_recourse*normalized_construction for candidates using delivery-selected wall system, where p_early_recourse=P(phase2 or phase3 nonstandard action).

name: final_selection
description: candidate pool: robust-feasible if nonempty, else post-mitigation-feasible, else baseline-feasible, else all. regret[d,w]=E(cost[d,w])-min_pool E(cost[w]); select minimum max regret; ties post-mitigation expected cost asc -> joint success desc -> post-mitigation p90 asc -> combination_index asc.

name: reported_metric_conventions
description: selected_expected_intensive_recourse_count=mean(nonstandard action count) for final-selected combination on post-mitigation baseline paths; expected_total_cost=post-mitigation baseline mean total_owner_cost of final-selected combination including mitigation fee; selected_maximum_cost_regret=max regret of final-selected combination in final candidate pool.

name: output_rounding
description: indices_and_counts=integer|factors=6|expected_counts=4|currency=2|strings=exact.
